household_purchase: branded style and discovery at a discount
economic_control_point: opportunistic buying physical assortment store productivity and repeat treasure-hunt traffic
main_burden_carrier: merchandise sourcing stores inventory turns labor and physical expansion
current_evidence: FY2025 1212 stores and more than 99% store sales; Q1 2026 sales 14% and comps 6%; 1242 stores after 40 openings
qoe_or_shenanigans_test: split comp traffic ticket price mix and openings; test inventory aging markdowns shrink vendor terms and turns
owner_cash_denominator: normalized store cash after merchandise rent labor maintenance openings leases taxes and dilution
valuation_and_macro_boundary: price must assume durable deal flow and store productivity; stress affordability freight labor and inventory funding
thesis_breaker: comps and store growth weaken while merchandise markdown shrink lease and labor burdens consume cash

household_purchase: low-ticket household discovery and feeling of finding a deal
economic_control_point: closeout sourcing flexible buying physical merchandising store rollout and deal-flow loyalty
main_burden_carrier: inventory selection store labor sourcing discipline and expansion capital
current_evidence: FY2025 sales 2649M; comps 3.7%; adjusted EBITDA 366.0M; 86 stores opened; about 17.0M loyalty members
qoe_or_shenanigans_test: separate loyalty count from causal retention; test closeout supply tariffs inventory turns shrink margin and expansion
owner_cash_denominator: closeout gross profit after inventory turns shrink labor expansion distribution leases taxes and capital
valuation_and_macro_boundary: price must assume recurring closeout supply and store returns; stress tariffs liquidity and household affordability
thesis_breaker: store and loyalty growth continue while comps margin or turns deteriorate

household_purchase: materials services and execution support for home upkeep
economic_control_point: Total Home relationship Pro access online ordering home services stores and delivery
main_burden_carrier: suppliers stores installers delivery labor inventory integration and capital
current_evidence: FY2025 sales 86.3B; comps 0.2%; Q1 2026 sales 23.1B; comps 0.6%; online sales 15.5%; Pro and home-services strength
qoe_or_shenanigans_test: separate organic Pro and service growth from online mix and acquisitions; test inventory receivables delivery cost integration and maintenance capital
owner_cash_denominator: cash after inventory receivable funding stores delivery services integration maintenance leases taxes debt and dilution
valuation_and_macro_boundary: price must assume thicker household relationship and upkeep demand; stress rates housing turnover materials inflation and credit terms
thesis_breaker: Pro online and home-services growth fail to produce margin and cash after delivery installation acquisition and maintenance burdens
